scope: Resource property presence query, conditional removal and payload clearing.

validation.case_scope: One focused fixture checks presence-only modes, exact low-byte removal mode, tail alias, removal of the mask and two indexed payloads, absent/out-of-range cases and red-zone ABI preservation. Action adjustments compose removal, and their fixture now verifies both linked properties are actually cleared instead of counting callbacks. Linked peer virtual behavior remains a service boundary; native gameplay is unvalidated. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
